title: Alphabet stock drops after the Google parent reshuffles top AI leadership
excerpt: The Google parent saw shares drop after news that DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis would take on a bigger role and a veteran AI research Jeff Dean is leaving.
content_html:
By Max Adams

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Investors don't appear to be thrilled with the shakeup in the ranks of Alphabet's top AI minds.

The stock dropped as much as 6% on Wednesday after news broke that DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis will assume an expanded role at Alphabet. It's a momentous shift for the trajectory of an exec who had recently been tipped a likely contended for Alphabet's next CEO.

The legendary AI researcher and leader of Google's AI efforts will become the chief scientist at Alphabet.

Meanwhile, Jeff Dean, a veteran AI researcher who has been with the tech titan for decades, is departing to start his own company.

Investors balked at the moves, with the stock tumbling around midday as news of the reshuffle broke.

The moves come at a sensitive time for the AI trade, with investors locked into every development among the hyperscalers that could determine their position in the AI arms race.

Alphabet was one of the tech companies that was punished by investors this earnings season for its heightened capex outlook, even as other big spenders like Microsoft and Amazon were rewarded.

content_html_zh:
作者：Max Adams 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

投资者似乎对 Alphabet 顶级人工智能人才队伍的变动并不感到兴奋。

DeepMind 首席执行官 Demis Hassabis 将在 Alphabet 担任更大职位的消息传出后，该股周三下跌了 6%。 对于一位最近被认为可能竞争 Alphabet 下一任首席执行官的高管来说，这是一个重大转变。

这位传奇的人工智能研究员和谷歌人工智能工作的领导者将成为 Alphabet 的首席科学家。

与此同时，在这家科技巨头工作了数十年的资深人工智能研究员杰夫·迪恩(Jeff Dean)即将离职，创办自己的公司。

投资者对这些举措犹豫不决，随着重组的消息传出，该股午盘暴跌。

这些举措发生在人工智能行业的敏感时期，投资者关注超大规模企业的每一项发展，这些发展可能决定他们在人工智能军备竞赛中的地位。

Alphabet 是本财报季因资本支出前景提高而受到投资者惩罚的科技公司之一，尽管微软和亚马逊等其他大笔支出者却获得了回报。
